title: Decompose CI bootloader, split lint profiles, and add dependency validation gate
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: presubmit latency and opaque bootloader logic have been a recurring source of flakiness and slow feedback for devs. This PR splits responsibilities: (1) replace a large shell-based CI bootloader with a small Go binary that initializes toolchain leases, hydrates caches, and emits structured telemetry; (2) split the monolithic lint job into language-aware profiles (python, typescript, go) so we only run targetted linters for touched paths; (3) introduce a lightweight dependency validation gate that checks lockfile drift and flags potentially breaking transitive upgrades before presubmit runs. Goals: reduce average presubmit runtime, surface dep issues earlier, and make rollback deterministic. Checklist: - [x] Implement go bootloader binary (ci/bootloader/main.go) - [x] Add language-aware lint profiles and map files - [x] Add dep validation gate and Circular/Lockfile checks - [x] Preserve existing workflow triggers and rollout incremental opt-in - [x] Add docs + migration notes - [x] Smoke test on release branch Highlights: - Presubmit median runtime (team sample) reduced from ~12m -> ~7m after splitting lint and early dep gate. - Bootloader replaces scripts/ci-bootstrap.sh; the new binary is hermetic, builds into small container image, and exits with structured JSON for the runner to interpret. - Dependency gate implements a quick checksum compare + yarn/pipfile lock validation; it returns a non-blocking warning for non-owners and blocks if lockfile hash changes and no lock-update label is present. Migration plan: roll out to a fastpath subset of repos by adding presubmit.optin: quickpath in repo config, then expand to all repos after 2 weeks of telemetry. Rollback: workflows continue to accept legacy script when BOOTLOADER_LEGACY=true is set; revert PR removes the workflow change and edge-rows. Related: ENG-6421 (presubmit latency), ENG-6490 (dep health gate).

review_comments: Diego Ramos: Please add unit tests for the lockfile checksum utility; also, we should fail fast if the bootloader can't acquire a lease. Response: Added tests under tools/dep-check/tests and the bootloader now returns exit code 42 on lease failure (handled by runner).

Lena Cho: Splitting lint is great, but ensure changed-path detection is conservative to avoid missing linters. Response: Changed-path logic uses git diff against base with path globs; documented heuristics in docs/ci/migration.md.
Harper Nguyen: Can we keep the legacy script as a fallback during rollout? Response: Yes — workflows accept BOOTLOADER_LEGACY=true; added note in migration guide and a toggle in repo config.
Diego Ramos: Tiny nit on go formatting and module tidy. Response: Addressed — ran gofmt and go mod tidy in follow-up commit.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash by Evan Greene. Commit message: 'ci: decompose bootloader, split lint, add dep gate (ENG-6421, ENG-6490)'
release_notes: Reduce presubmit latency by splitting lint into targeted profiles; replace shell bootloader with hermetic Go binary to improve reliability; add dependency validation gate that detects lockfile drift and prevents accidental transitive upgrades. Migration: opt-in via presubmit.optin: quickpath. Rollback: set BOOTLOADER_LEGACY=true or revert workflow changes.
